rows.grounds: verb from ā-hṛ, to take or seize away
compound of sa, akṣa, krīḍā, and rati
epithet or name of the goddess

items.question: How did Śivā, delighting in dice-play, seize her own sovereignty?
premises: Śivā is the agent of the action.
Śivā took away her own sovereignty.
items.inference: Śivā's delight in dice-play accompanies her seizure of her own sovereignty.
uncertainties: Whether svasāmrājyaṃ implies reclaiming or establishing sovereignty is context-dependent.
items.plain_english: Delighting in dice-play, the auspicious Śivā seized her own sovereignty.
